subject: Borealis evaluation milestones & kickoff — draft MAP
messages:
From: Emma Thomas <emma.thomas@borealis.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jason Lee <jason.lee@borealis.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Eval for Borealis — request MAP template

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — impressed by the latency numbers and the routing options. We need to get a Mutual Action Plan in place so we can move this through our internal eval and procurement cycle. High level asks from my side:

- A simple MAP template (timeline, owners, success criteria, checkpoints) we can share with execs
- A slide-friendly version for our leadership review next Friday (Nov 20)
- Any standard security/compliance artifacts (SOC2, data handling) we can attach

We aim to complete an internal POC in ~8 weeks and have procurement approve budget by Nov 29. Can you send a starter MAP and a proposed milestone cadence?

Attaching our initial requirements packet (small PDF).

Thanks,
Emma Thomas
Senior Data Platform Manager
Borealis Analytics
(attachment: Requirements_Rx_Packet.pdf)

Hi Emma — great to hear the demo landed well.

We have a lightweight MAP starter that covers milestones, stakeholders, success metrics, and risk/fallback options. I put a GDoc starter below (slide-friendly and editable):
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2bBorealis_MAP_Starter

What I included:
- Week-by-week milestones (discovery, POC, integration, exec review)
- Owner assignments (Redwood SE + Borealis counterparts)
- Clear success criteria for the POC (latency, cost per 1M tokens, integration points)
- Security checklist with SOC2 link and contact for evidence requests

Can you confirm the primary technical and legal contacts (for evidence/procurement)? We can also export this to Slides for Friday. Marcus will draft the slide pack and Aditya can provide the quant/cost model.

Suggested immediate next step: 30-minute kickoff on Monday Nov 16 to align owners and finalize the 8-week plan. Does 10:00–10:30 PT work?

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Tech lead: Jason Lee (jason.lee@borealis.ai)

Thanks — 10:00 PT Monday works for me.
